educationalGoal: In this course, students will acquire basic knowledge necessary for taking mathematics class in secondary education. This course covers the history, current status, and objective of mathematics education, the course of study “Mathematics”, and the content, materials, teaching methods and evaluation of mathematics.
advice:
In this course, students will learn basic knowledge necessary for taking mathematics class in secondary education as bellow.

 1. Mathematical education: history, PISA, objective, and evaluation
 2. Course of study “Mathematics”
 3. Overview of each area of mathematics, instruction, materials, and evaluation: set and logic, algebra, geometry, mathematical analysis, probability and statistics
 4. ICT for mathematics education
 5. Connection between junior high school and senior high school in mathematics

Students will take lectures and discuss their significance with each other.

              In this course, students will acquire basic knowledge necessary for taking mathematics class in secondary education. This course covers the history, current status, and objective of mathematics education, the course of study “Mathematics”, and the content, materials, teaching methods and evaluation of mathematics.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course, students will learn basic knowledge necessary for taking mathematics class in secondary education as bellow.

 1. Mathematical education: history, PISA, objective, and evaluation
 2. Course of study “Mathematics”
 3. Overview of each area of mathematics, instruction, materials, and evaluation: set and logic, algebra, geometry, mathematical analysis, probability and statistics
 4. ICT for mathematics education
 5. Connection between junior high school and senior high school in mathematics

Students will take lectures and discuss their significance with each other.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              ●Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology（2018） The Course of Study(Senior High School, Methematics).
●Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology（2017） The Course of Study(Junior High School, Methematics).

●Aim to obtain a Japanese teacher's license.
